what: Hand-drawn oval button made of two overlapping loops. On hover the oval line disappears, then is redrawn from the start point in .5s ease-in-out (line length 600, dashoffset 600→0). The text stays centered in the oval

options.--fx-dur: Redraw duration, default .5s (.8s in the original phone version)
options.--fx-len: Stroke length (dasharray), default 600 — must be longer than the ellipse circumference to erase fully
options.--fx-weight: Line thickness, default 2 (1 for the button group in the original Contact)
options.--fx-ink: Line color, default is the text color (currentColor)
options.[data-fx-part=oval]: Ellipse svg — every path inside is redrawn
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Text in the center of the ellipse (optional)

use: Listen in detail

from.where: shared.css .sr-draw (Contact at header right · Contact button group · Letter button)
